hold_reason: Discrepancy between the handoff and the ledger: W2 reported refunds applied for orders 180 (13791), 181 (17092), and 184 (3930), but list_refunds returns no refunds. Net balances may be overstated for acme (order 180), birch (orders 181 and 184), so no payouts were recorded. Needs human review of whether the refunds were applied before paying.
